meta.purpose: Professionals featured on career pages, with links to their own LinkedIn profiles.
rules: Only people who have given written (recorded) consent are listed; consent can be withdrawn at any time and the entry is then removed.
Profile data is supplied by the person, never collected from LinkedIn or any other site (LinkedIn's User Agreement prohibits scraping).
The LinkedIn URL is checked by a team member against the person's own confirmation before publishing.
No minors; no contact details beyond the public profile link the person chooses to share.

fields.name: name as the person wants it shown
fields.headline: current role and organisation, in the person's words
fields.story: optional one-paragraph journey, written or approved by the person
fields.checkedBy: team member who verified the link
fields.background: where they started (school, subjects, first job), in their words
fields.turningPoint: the decision or event that changed their path
fields.steps: array of short steps they took (study, certification, roles)
fields.lesson: one sentence of advice to students

meta.storyFormat: Career stories follow a case-study shape (background, turning point, steps, result) and end with a lesson, like short motivational stories. Every story is told or approved by the person; we never retell other sites' stories.
